title: Sunday · the motel from the lot
logline: Five weeks into nights. The Driftwood Motel from its lot at 5 AM, the office lit, one figure at the desk through the glass. The hum line under all three tiers for the first time in a Sunday.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the motel from the far corner of its lot at 5 AM, the two-story walkway, the office lit, a figure at the desk through the glass, small. The hum line beneath the tier.

characters.pose: at the desk, through the glass, small

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a two-story roadside motel seen from the far corner of its parking lot before dawn with the office lit and a small figure visible at the desk through the glass, a flat line beneath the panel, no words

panels.name: Office

panels.composition: Tier 2: the motel's sign, DRIFTWOOD, half its tubes lit, VACANCY lit. The hum line.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a motel's neon sign with some tubes dark and the word VACANCY lit, a flat line beneath the panel, no words

panels.name: Sign

panels.composition: Tier 3: the same view, dawn, the office light off, the figure gone from the glass. The hum line, still. Held.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, the same motel at gray dawn with the office dark and no figure in the glass, a flat line beneath the panel, no words

panels.name: Dawn

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: The motel as a Sunday. The hum line under tiers.
